title: Changes of Impact Force During Performance of Straight Punch With Two Boxing Techniques – Case Study
retraction_or_correction_status: no retraction or correction recorded in OpenAlex at accessed_at
notes: n=1. Recorded because the question is the right one, kept at low confidence because a single subject cannot answer it.
methodology: Single-subject comparison of straight punches with and without weight shifting; IMU suit, pressure insoles and an instrumented punch sensor.
main_findings: Treats weight transfer as the independent variable rather than as technique description.
limitations: single subject - directional at best, and not generalisable
the design cannot separate technique from this athlete
project_implications: Relevant only as a pointer to the weight-transfer question our "planted" locomotion mode already asserts without evidence.
